subject: [RFC PATCH v2 16/18] mm/shmem: count accesses to a folio the way filemap_read() does

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the way accesses to a folio in tmpfs are counted. Instead of only marking a folio as accessed when a read starts at its beginning, it marks the folio accessed unless the previous read through the file ended in the same position. This change ensures that reads that start anywhere within a folio count towards its access age, rather than just those that start at the beginning. Additionally, this patch sets PG_rcu_free on tmpfs folios that are repeatedly accessed.
